summary: Iteration 48 - Category Management in Settings & Document Type Filtering Testing Complete. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: 1) Settings page Category Management section with edit/delete functionality, 2) Document type filtering on Ultimate Search with all 13 types, 3) Filtered results display beneath map when filters active, 4) Article types endpoint returns all 13 document types, 5) Admin Moderation tab functional
critical_code_review_comments: Settings page Category Management properly displays tree structure with 11 categories
Edit panel shows category name, protocol, public checkbox, and price fields
Delete category button with cascade delete warning for sub-categories
Document type filtering on Ultimate Search shows all 13 types with color-coded checkboxes
Filtered Results section appears at bottom-center when filters are active
Clear filter button shows count of active filters

Article types endpoint returns all 13 types: PhD Informative, Personal Report (Organic/Collected), News Article, Academic Paper, Government, Wiki, Blog Post, Forum, Video, PDF Document, MS Word Document, Webpage
